features.notes: Better Player must remain separate from price/value and independent of sportsbook inputs.
Missing or stale markets cannot be shown as current or converted to zero.
Football projections remain independent of sportsbook pricing.
The UI consumes existing PICK/PASS outputs and cannot manufacture recommendations.
Existing player search/position filters and feature-specific filters must change only presentation/selection, never model outputs.
Weekly player decision only. START through SIT plus NO_CALL; no separate weekly Avoid feature.
Season-long sleeper/breakout identification using football evidence, historical/rookie priors and forward-looking role/context; price alone is insufficient.
Season-long downside opposite of breakout. Bust Candidate is football-only; Overpriced/Avoid may use downstream market cost. Not a weekly lineup feature.
Featured subset of existing valid game PICKS; no parallel betting engine.
Weekly NFL game warning signal. Trap is not an automatic opponent bet.
Historical context may display with adequate evidence; model weight requires stronger out-of-sample promotion standards.
